verdict.rationale: Pigment documents scenarios for assessing different assumptions (pigment-docs-11) and detailed application histories down to the data block level with full visibility into edit events (pigment-docs-16), plus an Audit Trail API for application events (pigment-docs-13). Together these suggest changes are traceable to users, but nothing ties that history to individual scenarios' assumptions or to scenario comparison. missing for 10: explicit per-scenario assumption records, documented attribution of who changed each scenario's assumptions, an auditable scenario-comparison view, independent or hands-on corroboration.
